profile.subtitleJa: ユダ王ヨラムの娘、アハズヤの姉妹。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記下11:2は、ヨシェバをヨラム王の娘、アハズヤの姉妹と記します。彼女はアハズヤの子ヨアシュをアタルヤから隠しました。
profile.identityNoteJa: 列王記下の綴りは「ヨシェバ」。歴代誌の異綴りを別名として自動的に加えず、この書の親族関係に基づく。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
